title: Hunt: Keys in the Code
story: A teammate shipped this code. Read it like an attacker and tap every risky line.

tests.label: Find every risky line, then pick the fix

hints: Look for places where outside input reaches something powerful.
socratic: Compare your result with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what attack does this code allow?

why_lines.3: A live key written in the file ends up in Git history for ever, and in every copy of the repo.
why_lines.4: Passwords in source code can be read by anyone who can read the code.

fix.question: Where should secrets live?
options: In a comment next to the code
In environment variables or a secret manager, and rotate any that leaked
fix.why: Keep secrets out of the repo. If one was committed, treat it as leaked and replace it.
